rows.label: bf04140100_0020
rows.name: So this is the imperial capital...

rows.label: bf04140100_0030
rows.name:
My blood is stirring, mo! Maybe they sell junk parts
I can use to upgrade Hana, mo!

rows.label: bf04140100_0050
rows.name:
Master, if possible, I'd like you to buy
new parts, mo...

rows.label: bf04140100_0060
rows.name: Excuse me, are you Tora-san, mo?

rows.label: bf04140100_0065
rows.name: It's been a while, mo. I'm Muimui, mo.

rows.label: bf04140100_0070
rows.name: Hm? Old man, you know Tora, mo?

rows.label: bf04140100_0080
rows.name: Ah, you don't remember me, mo.

rows.label: bf04140100_0100
rows.name:
I'm Muimui, assistant to your grandfather,
Professor Senzou, mo.
